name: Leadership
summary: The people who set MediHire’s staffing standard.
description: Leadership keeps the two journeys honest: hospitals get a clear request path, and clinicians see requirements before they apply.

seo.title: Leadership
seo.description: The people who set MediHire’s staffing standard.

name: Clinical partnerships
summary: Clinicians who advise on scope, credentialing, and unit fit.
description: Clinical partnerships review specialty requirements with hiring leaders so a request matches the unit that will receive the clinician.

seo.title: Clinical partnerships
seo.description: Clinicians who advise on scope, credentialing, and unit fit.

name: Recruiting
summary: Recruiters who help clinicians read an opening and take the next step.
description: Recruiting answers questions about shift, location, and employment type, then routes an application to the right reviewer.

seo.title: Recruiting
seo.description: Recruiters who help clinicians read an opening and take the next step.

name: Client operations
summary: The desk that turns a staffing request into a coverage plan.
description: Client operations confirms headcount, start window, and which service — temporary staffing, shift coverage, or permanent placement — fits the request.

seo.title: Client operations
seo.description: The desk that turns a staffing request into a coverage plan.

name: Quality and safety
summary: The review desk for credential files and handoff notes.
description: Quality and safety checks that a sample file has the license, specialty, and dates a hospital asked for before anyone is presented.

seo.title: Quality and safety
seo.description: The review desk for credential files and handoff notes.
